Game Center, iOS 4.1, 2010

Apple’s social gaming app, dressed as a casino card table of green felt framed in wood.

Source
Wikipedia: Game Center
Creator
Apple
Made
Released 8 September 2010 with iOS 4.1
Style
Skeuomorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Playful, tactile, warm
Evidence
No image of 800 px or more was found under a usable source. Based on Wikipedia and Fast Company (2012).
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Game Center was released to the public on 8 September 2010 with iOS 4.1. Its developer preview “had a dark appearance with abstract colors”; the release changed to “a lighter ‘game board’ appearance with more skeuomorphic design elements.” Wikipedia: Game Center.

A former Apple designer told Fast Company: “Steve pushed very hard to have everything—the felt-cloth table, the game chips—look like they would in real life.” Fast Company, Austin Carr, “Will Apple’s Tacky Software-Design Philosophy Cause A Revolt?” (2012).

Why it belongs

The shift from an abstract dark preview to felt and wood at release shows the style as a deliberate late choice, not a default.
